title: Crystalline form of N-(4-(4-(cyclopropylmethyl)piperazine-1-carbonyl)phenyl)quinoline-8-sulfonamide
abstract: Amorphous and crystalline hemi-sulfate forms of Formula (I) are provided herein.      Also provided herein are pharmaceutical compositions comprising amorphous and crystalline hemi-sulfate forms, methods of making them, and uses thereof, for treating conditions associated with pyruvate kinase, such as, for example, pyruvate kinase deficiency.
